THE STORIES BEHIND THE QUIZ

Sources & photo credits

Popular customs vary by family and region. Christmas, New Year and Three Kings’ Day are all part of this quiz. The suitcase ritual is shared by several countries; it is not exclusive to Colombia.

    Photographs & generated illustrations

      The four figurine option images were generated with OpenAI ImageGen. They illustrate the choices; the three incorrect figures are fictional distractors. The answer shows a real caganer photograph. Decorative holly, baubles and candy canes are original SVG artwork.
